name: linux-grep-multifile-heading-suppressed
description: ripgrep's --heading and color are isatty-sensitive: piped it prints inline path:line:text with no color, but on a TTY it groups matches under per-file heading blocks in color. lbabus grep prepends --color=never --no-heading so the output is byte-identical either way. Across TWO input files (where the TTY default would group under headings), assert every match is inline path-prefixed (basename tails sample.txt: and sample2.txt:) with no ANSI escape — the TTY-determinism guarantee, extended to the multi-file heading path.
